# The file STOP of a swarm stops new runs: a swarm that finds it starts no agent, and the parent ends with its report.
isolate
swarmfakes

exec beehestswarm item add swarm swarm-9 --title 'Again' --body-file backlog.txt
mkdir home/.swarm/swarm-1
cp stop home/.swarm/swarm-1/STOP
exec beehestswarm run swarm-9 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star
! exists calls.log
exec grep -rhao '0 landed, 0 need a person, 4 not started. Stopped: no new runs: the file STOP exists' state

-- stop --
-- backlog.txt --
P0	one	a.txt
P1	two	b.txt
P2	three	c.txt
P3	four	d.txt
